evidence: At 360x780, the large pagination extends from x=12 to x=431.7 while the viewport ends at 360. Its seven items total about 420px, the final page and next-arrow controls are cut off, and the document scrollWidth grows to 432px.
fix: Let the pagination wrap or shrink at narrow widths, or constrain it to the container with horizontal overflow instead of allowing its flex children to extend past the viewport.

evidence: At 360x780, the table is 465.1px wide inside a 330px .bs-component and ends at x=480.1. The fourth column is outside the screen and the document scrollWidth is 480px.
fix: Wrap the table in a width-constrained responsive container with overflow-x:auto, or reduce/stack columns at the phone breakpoint.

evidence: At 360x780, the large pagination has scrollWidth 419px inside a 330px container; its final controls reach x=433.9, beyond the 360px viewport.
fix: Allow the pagination to wrap or reduce page-control size at phone width so every item stays within its container.

evidence: At 360x780, the sidebar remains 260px wide and leaves .main-panel only 100px. Cards collapse to 40px, card headings get 10px text columns, and the task table wrapper is 10px wide around an 898px table; the dashboard content is squeezed and unreadable.
fix: Use an off-canvas/drawer sidebar below the responsive breakpoint and make .main-panel occupy the full viewport width when the sidebar is closed.

evidence: At 1440x900, the Users Behavior SVG is 706.7px wide and ends at x=1395, but its series paths extend to x=1621.1, about 226px beyond the SVG and 211px beyond the card edge at x=1410. The right side of the plotted area is cut at the chart boundary.
fix: Make the chart data/labels and SVG plotting viewport use the same horizontal scale, or regenerate the chart with all series points constrained to the visible viewBox.
